NO Mount Teide if ocean dominates; no imaginary site boundary, no plotted development. ARTEMIS — Atlantic Heritage Watercolour v1.0. Professional hand-drawn architectural travel-sketch in dark sepia fine nib ink and precise cross-hatching over translucent layered watercolour washes. Restrained high-end heritage aesthetic, true hand-crafted ink-and-watercolour look, never photorealistic or computer 3D. NO neon, NO fluorescent green, NO saturated tropical sea, NO giant palace, NO Greek temples, NO ornate amphoras, NO property deeds, NO investment props, NO labels, NO text, NO watermarks, NO claims of a real surveyed project site. Artistic concept only.
